# FDG9174

> DO include a Boolean parameter named “isFinalBlock,” if an `OperationStatus` method needs to treat the last input block in a special way. The parameter should be optional and have a default value of true.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.12.4 Partial Writes to Buffers and OperationStatus.

## How it is checked

- Check: fdg (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: FDG9174
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Message: Name the Boolean parameter '{0}' of '{1}' isFinalBlock, optional with a default value of true

FDG9174 reports a bool parameter of an externally visible method that returns OperationStatus when it is named isFinalBlock but is not optional with the default value true, or when a word of its name is Final or Last (ignoring case) and it is not named isFinalBlock, a parameter that marks the last input block under another name. Whether the method needs to treat the last block in a special way is not checked, so a method that needs the parameter and lacks it, or flags with other names, are not seen; overrides and interface implementations are not checked either, so coverage is partial. Span<T> and Memory<T> types need .NET Core 2.1 or later, or the System.Memory package on .NET Framework and .NET Standard 2.0 (see FDG9137). Renaming a parameter or changing its default value changes the public signature, so the fix is breaking; there is no code fix.

## From the book

For example, `ToBase64` needs to know whether the source buffer represents the final segment of the data so it can determine if it needs to treat an incomplete segment as `NeedsMoreData` or if it should write the padding characters. This would result in something like the following:

```csharp
public static OperationStatus ToBase64(
  ReadOnlySpan<byte> source,
  Span<byte> destination,
  out int bytesConsumed,
  out int charsWritten,
  bool isFinalBlock = true) {
  ...
  if (i < source.Length) {
    if (j + 4 <= destination.Length) {
      if (isFinalBlock) {
        // write the padded final block
        ...
        return OperationStatus.Done;
      }
      return OperationStatus.NeedsMoreData;
    }
    return OperationStatus.DestinationTooSmall;
  }
  return OperationStatus.Done;
}
```
